records.method: A native-source import rectangle encloses every pixel with alpha>24. Exact originalRGBA values inside that rectangle are retained, including alpha1..24. Only outer low-alpha fringe is excluded; no threshold alters a retained pixel. Original source-scale is frozen before this import, so other poses and all bases stay unchanged. Bottom aligns with median physical foot level of the three neighboring fatality poses, not with a stray alpha1 pixel.
